allow: PowerShell(Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name, Id, @{N='RAM_MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1\)}}, @{N='CPU_s';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU,1\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, @{N='Load_%';E={$_.LoadPercentage}})
PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, AdapterRAM, @{N='RAM_GB';E={[math]::Round\($_.AdapterRAM/1GB,1\)}}, DriverVersion, Status | Format-List)
